name: third-party.local-scanners
description: Curated provider manifest for local secrets, supply-chain and shell lint scanner capabilities.

source.upstreamOwner: Gitleaks, Trivy, ShellCheck, OSV and package-manager audit tool maintainers
source.upstreamSource: secleak-check / gitleaks / trivy; package-security-check / npm audit / pnpm audit / OSV; shellck / ShellCheck

secrets.scan.fallback: Manual secret scan with reviewed local commands and provider-hosted secret protection when available.

supplychain.scan.fallback: Manual package/dependency review with package manager audit, OSV, Trivy or GitHub Dependabot.

shell.lint.fallback: Manual shell script review with ShellCheck or equivalent local linting.

install.method: Install the selected local scanner CLIs through the project package manager or system package manager.
uninstall: Remove scanner CLIs that are no longer needed and remove this provider plugin from the AgentRig install set.

network: Optional vulnerability databases and GitHub security APIs when explicitly enabled
permissions.approval: Human approval required before uploading scan results, enabling hosted security changes or running broad filesystem scans.

transport.notes: Local scanner commands; optional network lookup only when the selected scanner requires it.

security.notes: Scanner commands can read sensitive project files. Default to project scope and show exact commands.

risk.notes: Local scans read source, manifests and possibly secrets; hosted integrations can expose repository metadata.
